questions.question: I saw ___ eagle flying above the hills.
questions.explanation: Use 'an' before a vowel sound. 'Eagle' begins with a vowel sound.

questions.question: She wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: Use 'an' before a vowel sound. 'Engineer' begins with a vowel sound.

questions.question: We visited ___ museum that you recommended.
questions.explanation: Use 'the' because the museum is identified by the phrase 'that you recommended'.

questions.question: My brother bought ___ new laptop yesterday.
questions.explanation: Use 'a' when mentioning one nonspecific singular countable noun for the first time.

questions.question: ___ moon looks bright tonight.
questions.explanation: Use 'the' for unique objects such as the moon.

questions.question: He is ___ honest person.
questions.explanation: The 'h' in 'honest' is silent, so the word begins with a vowel sound.

questions.question: She studies at ___ university in Mysuru.
questions.explanation: 'University' begins with a 'yoo' consonant sound, so use 'a'.

questions.question: Please close ___ door before you leave.
questions.explanation: Use 'the' when the listener can identify the particular door from the situation.

questions.question: My father reads ___ newspaper every morning.
questions.explanation: Use 'a' when referring to one newspaper in a general, nonspecific sense.

questions.question: ___ Ganga flows through several Indian states.
questions.explanation: Names of rivers generally take 'the'.

questions.question: She gave me ___ useful suggestion.
questions.explanation: 'Useful' begins with a 'yoo' consonant sound, so use 'a'.

questions.question: We had ___ lunch at noon.
questions.explanation: Meals generally take no article when referred to in a general sense.

questions.question: This is ___ most interesting book in the collection.
questions.explanation: Use 'the' before superlative adjectives.

questions.question: He plays ___ guitar very well.
questions.explanation: Musical instruments commonly take 'the' after verbs such as play.

questions.question: ___ children need a safe environment to grow.
questions.explanation: Plural countable nouns used in general statements take no article.

questions.question: She is ___ MBA graduate.
questions.explanation: MBA is pronounced 'em-bee-ay', beginning with a vowel sound.

questions.question: We climbed ___ Mount Everest in a documentary expedition story.
questions.explanation: Individual mountain peaks generally take no article before their names.

questions.question: I need ___ hour to finish this assignment.
questions.explanation: The 'h' in 'hour' is silent, so it begins with a vowel sound.

questions.question: She is ___ first person to arrive today.
questions.explanation: Ordinal numbers generally take 'the' when identifying position in an order.

questions.question: He wants to buy ___ pair of shoes.
questions.explanation: Use 'a' before the singular countable phrase 'pair of shoes'.
